script:
George (Janitor)
Congratulations, you have become George
Heaven is truly unfair to you. Not only are you disabled with leg problems, but you've also been listed as a suspect, involved in a suicide case. Yes, you believe this is just a suicide - this person completely brought it upon himself. Yesterday you did your usual cleaning work, and even in the morning you entered Johnny's cell. You didn't notice anything unusual, perhaps because Johnny was in the room, so you didn't observe carefully. But Johnny unexpectedly chatted with you for a few sentences: "Oh, George, do you think I'm an utterly evil person?" You were speechless, not knowing how to answer this question. Johnny didn't mind and continued: "If I were killed by enemies, would you sympathize with me?" Johnny stared straight at you, making you feel a bit panicked. You had long heard of his evil reputation - this kind of person should deserve what they get, right? But somehow, seeing him like this now, you really felt some sympathy. But you're just a small janitor, so you quickly left Johnny's room and continued cleaning other rooms. The other prisoners showed no abnormalities. You took the afternoon off yesterday, so you know nothing about what happened in the afternoon. You just went to the hospital to check your leg, returning to your dormitory in the prison only in the evening. Oh, right, this afternoon Johnny and Andrew were scheduled to do cleaning work. When you returned in the evening, you specifically inspected the situation, and it looked like it had indeed been seriously cleaned, but the water on the bathroom floor seemed more than usual. You didn't pay much attention to this. On your way back to your dormitory, you passed by the guard office and only saw Steven seemingly asleep on his desk. You didn't pay much attention, just noticed there seemed to be another figure in the office, but you quickly returned to your dormitory and fell asleep immediately. Oh, right, the wire you borrowed from 1601 to unclog the water tank hasn't been returned yet - this kind of thing shouldn't be left in prisoners' hands.
The next morning, you were awakened by a detective who told you Johnny had hanged himself. You were reflecting on what Johnny had said, but discovered you were also listed as one of the suspects because the police believe it was murder. You find this incredible, but you must cooperate with the investigation and find the real killer to clear your name.
Character Relationships:

1601 Ken & John - Two young guys, said to be Johnny's subordinates, but you've seen them fighting each other more than once
1603 Clark - He hardly ever leaves his cell, you don't know much about him
1603 Andrew - A cunning prisoner who likes to slack off, but gets along well with you
Guard Steven - Honestly, you quite dislike him. He likes to pursue profit, often accepts bribes from prisoners, and oppresses other prisoners

Your Dark Side:
Your leg was crippled by Johnny's subordinates (not Ken and John), and you've always had some underlying illness that can't be cured, so you've always harbored revenge against Johnny. You put laxatives in his food and stole his notes, hoping to discover more of his crimes and make him stay longer. But he was about to be released recently, and you had no way to stop it. But now he's dead - should you be happy or sympathetic?
Your Statement to the Detective:
Respected Detective:
I'm just an ordinary janitor with disabled legs, let alone killing someone so much stronger than me. I went to the hospital yesterday afternoon to check my bad leg and only returned to the prison in the evening, so I really don't know what happened in the afternoon. The last time I saw Johnny was yesterday morning when cleaning his cell. He even chatted with me for a few sentences and seemed perfectly normal. Although I hate criminals, I still sympathize with his death. After all, he could have been released in two days and had a chance to reform. Sigh. Officer, you ask what he talked to me about - he just asked if he was a sinner and whether I would sympathize with him if he died. I didn't answer him, but what he said actually came true - it's incredible. I stayed in my dormitory at night, not in the same building as them, so I couldn't detect any unusual movements from their side. I don't know the other prisoners very well either. When cleaning, I barely exchange a few words with them, but our relationship is okay. As for guard Steven, my impression of him isn't very good. He shouldn't treat prisoners that way, and he seems to have some profit relationship with Johnny. I've seen them making deals, and Johnny had communication devices in his room that Steven gave him. That's all I know. I hope the detective can properly investigate Steven's affairs. Oh, right, the two people in 1603 are also somewhat abnormal and quite suspicious. I hope the detective can solve the case quickly.
acts_goal:
Find the killer
Guard your dark side
